skill_fireball_desc: Shoots a fireball that deals damage to enemies.
item_goblin_ear_desc: Proof of a kill. Cannot be traded or sold.
item_wolf_pelt_desc: A fine pelt the blacksmith is looking for.
item_ancient_letter_desc: A letter under a worn wax seal. The text is hard to make out.
quest_goblin_hunt_desc: Goblins have grown bold in the Dark Forest. Speak with the village elder.
quest_goblin_chief_desc: The forest stays restless until the chief leading them falls.
quest_field_cleanup_desc: Slimes or wolves — thin out whatever is fouling the fields.
quest_first_steps_desc: Head beyond the village and grow a little stronger.
quest_first_steps_stage1_desc: Reach the forest and level up
quest_daily_wolf_desc: A standing daily contract to thin the wolf packs.
quest_ancient_letter_desc: Find the letter and bring it to the elder before it is lost.
quest_event_preview_desc: An event quest that has not opened yet.
dlg_elder_greet: What brings you here, young one?
dlg_elder_ask_work: Do you have work for me?
dlg_elder_goblin_intro: Goblins have grown thick in the dark forest. I could use a hand.
dlg_elder_merchant_intro: A merchant has lost his way. Someone needs to see him home.
dlg_blacksmith_greet: Working iron takes patience, not strength. Need something?
item_smuggler_tally_desc: The destination was scraped off and written again. The ship's name is in no ledger in Seiren Port.
item_torn_logbook_desc: Pages have been ripped out. What remains charts constellations, not sea lanes.
item_mural_rubbing_desc: A ruin mural traced onto paper. The shape looks like a bird — with four wings.
quest_missing_ships_desc: Three ships due back in Seiren Port have gone silent. Harbormaster Maren is looking for help.
quest_rinne_shortcut_desc: Rinne says the ships vanished over land, not water. Proving it means looking past Windgate Pass.
quest_rinne_shortcut_stage1_desc: Clear the wolves on the pass
quest_smuggler_tally_desc: Goblins on the pass are hauling cargo. Goblins do not haul cargo — someone put them to it.
quest_verdant_problem_desc: The seal on the tally belongs to House Verdant of the north. Their son happens to be causing trouble at the edge of the Ashen Wood.
quest_verdant_problem_stage2_desc: Clean up the mercenaries Kyle hired
quest_torn_logbook_desc: Kyle does not defend his house. He says the missing ship's logbook lies deeper in the wood.
quest_ashen_ruins_name: The Ruins of the Ashen Wood
quest_ashen_ruins_desc: The logbook charts constellations instead of sea lanes. Aisha already seems to know where they point.
quest_the_vanished_desc: The missing were inside the ruins. What dragged them there was not a monster. It was people.
quest_four_winged_mural_desc: The disappearances are solved. Yet on the innermost wall of the ruins hangs a picture nobody can explain.
quest_four_winged_mural_stage1_desc: Break the guardian and take the rubbing
dlg_maren_ask_ships: Tell me about the ships that never returned.
dlg_maren_missing_ships: They did not sink. If they had, something would have washed up. Three ships, gone whole.
dlg_maren_accept_mural: I'll search deeper in the ruins.
dlg_rinne_greet: You're late. I've already asked three sailors.
dlg_rinne_shortcut: My father took me along it as a kid. Faster than the sea lane. More wolves, though.
dlg_rinne_report_shortcut: I went down to the farm road and back.
dlg_rinne_ask_tally: About the cargo those goblins were hauling.
dlg_rinne_tally: Ever seen a goblin haul cargo? Me neither. Someone put them to it.
dlg_rinne_accept_verdant: Let's find whoever owns that seal.
dlg_kyle_greet: That's either the face of someone collecting a debt or someone dragging me home. I'll pass on both.
dlg_kyle_report_orc: Your hired swords are dealt with.
dlg_kyle_ask_logbook: Your family's seal was on the tally.
dlg_kyle_logbook: I know. That's why I'm out here instead of at home. The missing ship's logbook is deeper in this wood.
dlg_aisha_greet: People who come this far are one of two kinds. Lost, or pretending to be.
dlg_aisha_report_logbook: Take a look at this logbook.
dlg_aisha_ruins: Every stone in this wood faces the same way. Too diligent for coincidence.
dlg_aisha_accept_ruins: Let's go all the way in.
